messages:
Priya (Product): Thanks everyone — quick follow-ups from today's all-hands security segment. A few customers asked about BYOK rotation guarantees, HSM support for Private, DSAR handling for hosted logs, and ISO evidence timing. Can we get a concise follow-up thread?
Leah (Head of Security): Yep — happy to summarize. I'll go item by item.
Priya (Product): Awesome, thanks.
Leah (Head of Security): 1) BYOK / KMS rotation: we support customer-managed keys for Private + Dedicated via BYOK. Rotation policy: we recommend a 90-day rotation window by default but we won't force automatic rewrap for customer keys. If customers want automated rotation we can offer a managed key rotation add-on (opt-in).
Anya (Compliance): To add: for SOC2/ISO evidence we'll need rotation logs showing key versioning, wrap/unwrap events, and access trail for the evidence package. Aim to surface those as downloadable CSVs in Console.
Kai (Eng-Infra): Tech note: Private deployments will integrate with customer KMS endpoints (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) over private networking. For on-prem HSMs we have a connector agent that speaks KMIP; HSM support is gated behind an engineering checklist (HSM cert, latency testing, HSM credential management).
Priya (Product): Can we commit a timeline for HSM connector GA? Customers keep asking.
Jordan (CTO): Short answer: GA target for HSM connector is end of Q3 (subject to a few large-customer pilot tests). We'll run 2 pilot integrations in May/June — if those go well we'll advertise GA.
Sam (Privacy): DSARs: for hosted API customers, logs that contain only request metadata are retained per retention policy; request/response content is ephemeral unless customer opts in to log retention. For Private/Dedicated we're not ingesting customer payloads in our control plane — DSAR handling is customer responsibility, but we'll provide tooling to export audit metadata.
Priya (Product): Can we clarify audit log replication cross-region? Some customers want immutable replicas.
Kai (Eng-Infra): Current plan: we will replicate audit logs to a customer-configurable destination (S3/GCS) with versioning and lifecycle rules. Immutable replication (WORM) depends on the storage provider features — we'll document supported setups and provide configuration recipes.
Anya (Compliance): ISO timeline: evidence package automation (for control evidence like access reviews, rotation proof, network diagrams) — M1: export templates (June), M2: self-serve evidence bundles (August), M3: auditor-access toggles (September). These are soft dates.
Leah (Head of Security): Action items from this thread: 1) Leah to publish a short FAQ in Docs on BYOK rotation & managed rotation add-on. 2) Kai to post HSM connector pilot checklist + pilot signup form. 3) Anya to publish ISO evidence timeline and what docs auditors will expect.
Priya (Product): Could someone drop links to the current docs and a short blurb we can share with customers?
Kai (Eng-Infra): Linking the internal HSM design doc: https://internal.redwood/hsm-design (draft). Pilot signup: https://forms.redwood/hsm-pilot (internal).
Leah (Head of Security): BYOK FAQ draft: https://internal.redwood/byok-faq (I'll tidy and publish later today).
Anya (Compliance): ISO evidence checklist (draft): https://internal.redwood/iso-evidence-checklist.
Sam (Privacy): I'll add a short customer-facing DSAR blurb for hosted vs private: will share in this thread when done.
Priya (Product): Amazing — thanks. Small ask: can we include an explicit statement on who owns DSAR responses for Private deployments? Customers want this in writing.
Leah (Head of Security): Yes — simple policy: for Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments where the customer controls KMS/network/storage, the customer is responsible for responding to DSARs for customer data in their deployment. Redwood will assist with metadata exports and any platform-level logs we control. We'll put a one-paragraph policy in the FAQ.
Jordan (CTO): Also adding: SLA note — for Dedicated & Private support tiers, we will include assistance timeboxed in contracts for DSAR exports; exact scope negotiable during procurement.
Kai (Eng-Infra): Technical caveat: for HSM-backed keys where keys never leave the HSM, some forensic traces are limited to HSM audit logs — coordinate with the customer's HSM operator for DSAR evidence.
Priya (Product): Thanks all. Can someone file the quick tickets so we can track progress?
devops-bot: Created ticket SEC-421 "Publish BYOK FAQ + policy blurb" and SEC-422 "HSM pilot checklist & signup".
Leah (Head of Security): I'll take SEC-421.
Kai (Eng-Infra): I'll take SEC-422 and kick off the pilot invites.
Anya (Compliance): I'll own the ISO evidence task and link SEC-423 here once created.
Sam (Privacy): Drafting DSAR blurb now, will paste in ~30m. :thumbsup:
Priya (Product): Perfect. I'll round up customer asks and share a single customer-facing FAQ bundle once the drafts are live. Thanks everyone!
Leah (Head of Security): Thanks — closing the loop. If partners need NDA-level detail, we'll coordinate via Legal.
Priya (Product): Noted.
devops-bot: Updated tickets: SEC-421 assigned to Leah, SEC-422 assigned to Kai, SEC-423 pending (Anya).
